items.title: Crypto Long & Short: Inside the 300-to-1 onchain gap between the dollar and euro
items.title_tr: Kripto Uzun ve Kısa: Dolar ve Euro arasındaki 300 'e 1 zincir içi boşluğun içinde
items.article_summary: RockawayX'ten Ryan Connor, doların euro'yu zincir dışı ekonomide yaklaşık 3 'e 1 ve zincirde 300' den fazla 1 'e kadar yönlendirdiğini yazıyor. Euro'ya sabitlenmiş stablecoin'ler, arzın % 1' inin altında toplam 711 milyon € tutarındadır. Yol bağımlılığı ve eksik euro DeFi altyapısı arasındaki boşluğu takip ediyor ve MiCA tarafından düzenlenen ihraç ve euro vault raylarının bunu değiştirdiğini savunuyor.

items.article_summary_en: Ryan Connor of RockawayX writes that the dollar leads the euro about 3 to 1 across the offchain economy and more than 300 to 1 onchain. Euro-pegged stablecoins total €711 million, under 1% of supply. He traces the gap to path dependency and missing euro DeFi infrastructure, and argues MiCA-regulated issuance and euro vault rails are changing it.

items.article_summary_en: Nasdaq's venture capital arm agreed to invest $100 million in Payward, the parent company of crypto exchange Kraken, to build infrastructure for tokenized equities, the company said Thursday. Nasdaq said the collaboration is being led by its Digital Liquidity Networks division, which focuses on building around-the-clock market infrastructure. "The next era of market evolution will be defined by how efficiently and seamlessly capital and assets move across the financial system with durable liquidity," Nasdaq President Tal Cohen said in a statement. The next phase of the collaboration is planned to advance Nasdaq Equity Tokens onto rails that do not close, with shareholder rights intact." As part of the expanded relationship, Payward has additionally agreed to integrate Nasdaq's market surveillance tools into its trading operations, spanning asset classes including crypto, equities, tokenized equities, futures, and options, Nasdaq said.
